page: Microsoft Azure E32ads_v6 is an Eadv6-series virtual machine powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, this server features 32 virtual CPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The CPU runs at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz and includes 32 MB of L3 cache. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance includes 1890 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The CPU supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AVX512_BF16, and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPU hardware.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core CPU performance, with top-25% scores in stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests. Multi-core performance is average overall, though Geekbench multi-core and image processing metrics rank in the top 25%. Memory performance is robust, with PassMark memory scores in the top 25%, while uncached memory bandwidth reads reach 75.65 GB/sec. Large-block uncached memory writes perform at 55.63 GB/sec. For lightweight language model workloads, the server achieves top-tier text generation speeds of 341.89 tokens/sec on a small 135M model.

Given its high resource density, the E32ads_v6 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that require fast local scratch space. The combination of 256 GB of RAM and local NVMe storage makes this server well-suited for relational databases, in-memory caching layers, data analytics, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
